messages:
zara: getting a flood of support pings  403s on API calls and missing billing for multiple tenants since ~08:45 UTC. customers say keys unchanged.
mike: metrics show auth.verify_errors spike at 08:46 and jwks_fetch_failures tick up. logs show `jwt: kid not found` in verification layer.
infra-bot: scheduled job jwks-rotator started at 08:40 UTC (rotation-id=rot-2026-04-11). step sequence: publish-new-key -> wait-propagation -> prune-old-key. job returned OK at 08:44.
eng-oncall: initial theory  prune step may have removed old key before all verifier caches had fetched new jwks. look at rotator logs: `08:44:12 prune: replicas_ready=false; forcing prune due to timeout; status=success`. that "forcing" is suspicious.
sre: reproducer: grab a token minted 08:39 (pre-rotation), then hit verifier in ap-SE cluster that didn't fetch new jwks:
```
curl -s -X POST https://auth.internal/v1/introspect \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <old-token>" -d "client_id=tenant-x" | jq
# => {"active":false,"error":"invalid_signature","detail":"kid missing"}
```
Works against nodes that refreshed JWKS, fails against stale nodes.
support-ontcall: customers affected: BrightLab, Nimbus, Peerly. created tickets SUP-5013 SUP-5014 SUP-5015. all report ~20-35m interruption. sending interim status.
finance: billing notes: our event pipeline drops usage events when introspect returns inactive. looking at ingestion logs theres a gap from 08:46-09:05 for these orgs. we will need to reprocess or backfill.
eng-oncall: quick mitigation options: 1) roll rotator back to previous state (unprune) 2) re-introduce old key into jwks endpoints (hotpatch) 3) force all verifier nodes to refresh jwks and restart failing containers.
infra-bot: runbook recommends forcing JWKS refresh first. executing: `ssm run --targets tag=auth-node --command "/opt/auth/bin/refresh-jwks --no-cache"`
mike: refresh succeeded on most nodes but 4 nodes in ap-SE returned `kms: handshake failed`. those nodes couldn't fetch private key material to validate (KMS proxy issue). restarting kms-proxy on those hosts now.
sre: after restarting kms-proxy, jwks refresh completed. verified via `curl https://auth.ap-se.internal/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'` shows both kids present. smoke tests: sample old token now validates on all regions.
eng-oncall: rolled a targeted re-deploy of verifier pool with staggered restarts to clear any lingering caches. also lowered CDN edge cache TTL from 60s to 5s for introspect path for the next hour to speed propagation.
support-ontcall: notified customers of mitigation. BrightLab reported recovery at 09:03 and asked for credit; created SUP-5013-BILL.
mike: root cause draft: rotator had a safety timeout that would prune after X seconds even if replica acks were missing. combined with a transient KMS proxy failure in ap-SE (handshake timeouts) those verifier nodes never fetched new JWKS and then the old key was removed, producing invalid_signature failures for tokens minted before rotation. edge CDN caching extended the blast window.
eng-oncall: actions taken: rollback prune logic, hotpatch rotator to `require_strict_replica_ack=true`, push PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/jwks-rotation/pulls/471, force jwks refresh and restart nodes, lower cache TTLs.
sre: post-incident items: 1) add per-region ack gating in rotation job, 2) add KMS proxy health gating before prune, 3) increase observability for jwks_fetch_failures and add alert for >0 fetch_failures across any region during rotations, 4) add a dry-run canary that mints a test token and validates across verifier pools before prune.
finance: will run backfill for usage events 08:45-09:05 for affected tenants and coordinate credits; creating BILL-227.
support-ontcall: timeline for customers: 08:40 rotation started, 08:44 rotate job pruned old key, 08:46 first customer errors, 09:03 mitigation restored validation, impact window ~17-23m depending on region. customers updated.
zara: owners assigned: mike infra changes, eng-oncall for canary tests, sre for runbook updates, finance for billing reconciliation, support for customer comms.
eng-oncall: incident doc created: https://wiki.internal/incidents/2012345678-jwks-propagation-ttl-regression. will draft the postmortem and link PRs.
support-ontcall: current status 09:30 UTC: systems stable, tickets open, backfills queued. closing thread after postmortem posted. :white_check_mark:
